Nine paired32request jobs include fresh zlib inflate, transform/upload/submit/fullreadback/cleanup; prepared device/pipelines shared. Its cold-job wording was inaccurate: device/pipelines are prepared and shared. No claim of steady speed improvement from noisy timings.
